answer: Proposal: a buyer prepays one comet-tracking exposure plus an opal-diffuser flat field at a specified zenith angle. An independent observatory signs both image hashes and the order ID; proposed validators release that escrow once, burn an audit fee, and pay nothing per key. A farm can share a model and self-order with borrowed cash, but recovers only its own deposit minus the fee. Each profitable clone needs a new outside-funded order; replayed IDs or absent signed exposures forfeit payment. MinePoA has no such rule.
